newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks rise slightly, all eyes on banks.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks rise slightly, all eyes on banks.

text.p: Estonian shares rose slightly on stronger trade on Tuesday with the market anticipating gains in the bank sector as banks report their January earnings figures, dealers said.
"The market is awaiting the release of January balance sheet figures and there is a strong expectation of good profits in the banking sector as Forekspank showed today," one trader said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index rose slightly by 0.45 percent to close at 187.63 on turnover of 58 million kroons.
Hansapank was the most active on turnover of 19.5 million kroons to slip lower by 0.35 kroons to 176.50.
Forekspank was buoyed by news of a strong profit figure for January. It rose to 3.35 kroons to end at 150.10 kroons after turning over 10.5 million kroons.
The bank earlier said it made a January profit of 10.7 million kroons, a near 60 percent rise on December's profit.
Elsewhere, Savings Bank climbed to 91.00 kroons, a rise of 4.10 kroons, with a 8.3 million kroons of shares changing hands.
Tallinna Pank traded 7.5 million kroons but remained stable on 67.00 kroons.
On the over-the-counter market, Rakvere was most traded with 3.2 million kroons changing hands to rise by 0.15 kroons to 15.65 kroons.
"Everyone has big expectations for Rakvere, it is expected to make a profit, but there is little information, so it remains a highly speculative stock," said one dealer.
Tallinn Department store also rose to close at 84.40 kroons, up 0.50 kroons, on trade of 1.6 million kroons.
